name: Walter Burgwyn Jones
summary: Walter Burgwyn Jones (October 16, 1888 – August 1, 1963) was an Alabama circuit court judge, state legislator, attorney, and writer from Montgomery, Montgomery County. As a judge and avowed white supremacist, he played key roles in several notable civil rights cases attempting to stymie the advancement of civil rights in Alabama. An active community member, he served on numerous boards and held active leadership roles in many community organizations.
